updates.finding: Reuters now describes the Sep.22 contact as first known indirect talks since the July ceasefire collapse: FM Abbas Araqchi and US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner communicated through mediators. Iranian spokesperson Esmail Baghaei says Qatar mediated and Iran conveyed conditions including ending the war on all fronts and halting US acts of aggression. Pezeshkian publicly maintained Iran would not surrender while endorsing diplomacy. Public positions show no established concession or settlement yet.
updates.status: CONTACT CONFIRMED; INDIRECT FORMAT SUPPORTED; NO AGREEMENT ESTABLISHED
updates.drawer_effect: Supersede any summary implying an established direct bilateral meeting; preserve prior reporting/claims and distinguish Trump characterization from Reuters' current indirect-talk reconstruction.

updates.update_type: claims/authority lineage / correction to prior two-condition shorthand
updates.finding: Iranian state media, reported by Reuters, says Araqchi conveyed Hormuz reopening conditions to Witkoff: immediate lifting of the naval blockade, immediate release of frozen Iranian assets, and an end to war across all 'resistance' fronts. This materially qualifies the prior shorthand that Hormuz reopening had narrowed to only two conditions. Atlas preserves the earlier unnamed-official two-condition report but does not treat five conditions as abandoned.
updates.status: THREE PUBLIC CONDITIONS NOW ATTRIBUTED TO STATE MEDIA; SEVEN-VS-THREE-VS-TWO RELATION UNRESOLVED
updates.drawer_effect: Update Hormuz claim-position lineage; do not describe the current authoritative position as simply two conditions. Track whether three are Hormuz-specific while seven govern broader settlement.

updates.finding: SNSC secretary Mohsen Rezaei told Iranian state TV Iran would ensure neighboring countries' airports could not function if they stop Iranian flights under US secondary-sanctions pressure. This is an official threat by a high-authority national-security official; it does not establish execution or capability against any specific airport.
updates.status: OFFICIAL THREAT CONFIRMED; EXECUTION NOT ESTABLISHED
updates.drawer_effect: Append to aviation-sanctions implementation and regional coercion drawers; watch Iraq/other neighboring airport operations and Iranian military follow-through.

updates.finding: Kpler preliminary data showed three commodity vessels transited Hormuz Tuesday, all outbound, versus four Monday and a 10-day moving average near 15. Al Mafyar, a ballast LNG tanker, reappeared inside the strait. AIS-dark passages remain a known denominator limitation.
updates.status: TRAFFIC REMAINS SEVERELY DEPRESSED; PRELIMINARY DATA
updates.drawer_effect: Update daily Hormuz traffic series; retain preliminary/AIS caveat.

updates.finding: Kpler data reported 22 commodity vessels transited Bab el-Mandeb Tuesday, 14 toward the Red Sea and eight toward the Gulf of Aden, below the 10-day average of about 26.
updates.drawer_effect: Append daily Bab el-Mandeb traffic denominator and directionality.

updates.finding: UKMTO reported a vessel struck Wednesday by an unknown projectile while transiting Hormuz; fire followed and crew evacuated. Origin/attribution was unclear at evidence horizon.
updates.drawer_effect: Append as separate Hormuz vessel incident; do not assign perpetrator absent evidence.

updates.finding: AP reconstruction based on 10 officials/soldiers reports IRGC advisers were in the field helping direct the Houthi Red Sea-coast offensive. Sources said advisers were present at all levels, including tactical planning/front-line command, and provided communications/satellite-intelligence analysis. AP reports the offensive covered about 115 km and Mokha was abandoned as Houthis entered Sep.10. Iran's UN mission did not respond to AP requests for comment.
updates.status: MULTI-SOURCE AP ATTRIBUTION; MATERIAL UPGRADE OVER GENERIC IRAN-BACKING CLAIMS; NOT OFFICIAL IRANIAN ADMISSION
updates.drawer_effect: Update prior Iran-Houthi support drawer from generalized support toward reported direct field-adviser involvement; preserve source anonymity and lack of Iranian confirmation.

updates.finding: Reuters reported oil near two-week lows amid improving Gulf crude supplies and diplomacy expectations; Brent had touched $97.36 in the prior session. Diesel/gasoil margins remained exceptionally elevated amid disrupted Middle East product supplies and discussion of a possible US diesel export ban.
updates.drawer_effect: Append market response; do not treat price movement alone as proof of diplomatic success.
